PSA 47:1.KJV: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
PSA 47:1.BHSA: כָּֽל־הָ֭עַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָ֑ף הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים בְּקֹ֣ול רִנָּֽה׃

PSA 47:2.KJV: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
PSA 47:2.BHSA: כִּֽי־יְהוָ֣ה עֶלְיֹ֣ון נֹורָ֑א מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝דֹול עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

PSA 47:3.KJV: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
PSA 47:3.BHSA: יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑ינוּ וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ׃

PSA 47:4.KJV: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
PSA 47:4.BHSA: יִבְחַר־לָ֥נוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵ֑נוּ אֶ֥ת גְּאֹ֨ון יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

PSA 47:5.KJV: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
PSA 47:5.BHSA: עָלָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּקֹ֣ול שֹׁופָֽר׃

PSA 47:6.KJV: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
PSA 47:6.BHSA: זַמְּר֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים זַמֵּ֑רוּ זַמְּר֖וּ לְמַלְכֵּ֣נוּ זַמֵּֽרוּ׃

PSA 47:7.KJV: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
PSA 47:7.BHSA: כִּ֤י מֶ֖לֶךְ כָּל־הָאָ֥רֶץ אֱלֹהִ֗ים זַמְּר֥וּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃

PSA 47:8.KJV: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
PSA 47:8.BHSA: מָלַ֣ךְ אֱ֭לֹהִים עַל־גֹּויִ֑ם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יָשַׁ֤ב׀ עַל־כִּסֵּ֬א קָדְשֹֽׁו׃

PSA 47:9.KJV: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
PSA 47:9.BHSA: נְדִ֘יבֵ֤י עַמִּ֨ים׀ נֶאֱסָ֗פוּ עַם֮ אֱלֹהֵ֢י אַבְרָ֫הָ֥ם כִּ֣י לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים מָֽגִנֵּי־אֶ֗רֶץ מְאֹ֣ד נַעֲלָֽה׃
